title: Holding the Line
blurb: You've come to Dry Gulch on the railroad's Reclamation Charter: free title and a bounty on every bug. Hold the cliffs five nights.

telegram.title: Dry Gulch Reclamation Charter
telegram.body: WESTERN PLAINS AND PACIFIC TO THE RANCHERS OF DRY GULCH STOP FOLLOWING THE REGRETTABLE MINING ACCIDENT OF 1889 FREE TITLE TO ANY SETTLER WHO HOLDS THE RIMS STOP BOUNTY PAID ON EVERY PEST STOP CANYON FLOOR TO BE LEFT UNDISTURBED FOR PUBLIC SAFETY STOP BARRELS NOT TO DIP BELOW THIRTY DEGREES STOP THE LAW INSISTS STOP C VANE CHAIRMAN

build: stroud
Morning, ranchers. Captain Ada Stroud, airship Lucky Mandible. The railroad's paying, and the bugs are coming.
stroud
Your guns can't dip at your own wall. Thirty degrees, by law. So you cover your partner's.
kettle
Pell's Toes. Governor Pell shot three off firing down at a rattler in '71. Now we all suffer.
stroud
The railroad's charter is on your house board. Free land, a bounty, kind regards. Read it, then throw the lever.
wave: Here they come. Watch the far wall, not your feet.
held: First night held. Patch up, plant something, and keep your partner's wall clean.

build: kettle
Silas Kettle, gunsmith, aboard the ship. Bring me chitin and I'll bring you calibre.
wave: Bigger batch tonight. Mind the lanes on your partner's side.

build: pearl
Pearl Doyle, casino deck. Lose a little scrap with me sometime. I hear things worth knowing.
wave: My spyglass shows dust in every tunnel. Steady now.

build: kettle
I rigged blasting for the railroad crew in '89. That tunnel didn't hit rock. It hit something hollow.
stroud
The charter calls it a mining accident. Funny sort of accident that pays bounties for twelve years.
wave: One more night after this. Don't get comfortable.

build: stroud
Bad news on the wire. Something big is coming up the tunnel. They call it the Hive Wagon.
kettle
A beetle the size of a stagecoach. Aim for the soft parts. Assuming it has any.
wave: There's the Wagon. Every gun on it, ranchers!

boss_down: The Wagon's down! The railroad will want a photograph.
win: Five nights held. You've earned your keep, and a hat. Captain's orders.
The railroad wired its congratulations. First time I've seen them pay early. Makes me itch.
lost: We lost a house. Regroup. We'll fly it again from the top.

journal.title: Specimen Notes, No. 1
journal.body:
The Hive Wagon's plating is grown, not shed. It wears its armour like a coat. Something down here does the tailoring.

I have asked the Captain to stop calling me 'the Mole'. She has not stopped.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: Ranchers Hold Dry Gulch; Hive Wagon Derailed
